items.title: Temple shocks Memphis, 35-31, in season finale
items.summary: The Owls, as 17.5-point underdogs, twice erased a 17-point, second-half deficit to beat the Tigers on the road Friday.

items.title: Smolik Finds Bermudez Late as Owls Top Memphis on the Road
items.summary: MEMPHIS, Tenn. – Temple football closed its 2026 season with a thrilling 35-31 comeback victory over Memphis on Black Friday at Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium. The Owls outscored the Tigers 28-7 from the 10:40 mark in the third quarter, including 21 unanswered points in the fourth.

items.title: Gameday Preview: Temple at Memphis
items.summary: Temple's disappointing season will come to an end today against an 8-3 Memphis team. Find out the key matchups, players and stats here.

items.title: Temple Owls Black Friday Special: 75% off OwlScoop
items.summary: With so much taking place, OwlScoop.com is ensuring fans keep up on all the latest scoop by offering 75% OFF annual memberships.

items.title: The Scoop: S12, E17 - Stuffed with questions, starved for answers
items.summary: After football's loss to Rice and men's basketball's two ugly losses at the Paradise Jam, we responded with a mailbag-heavy podcast to answer fans' questions about what lies ahead for both programs.

items.title: Owls in the NFL - Week 11
items.summary: Winning continues in Buffalo, as the Bills extended their winning streak to six games with a 26-9 victory over the Miami Dolphins. Left tackle Dion Dawkins (2013-16) once again played a key role in the Bills' offense, which totaled 405 yards, while safety Sam Franklin (2016-19) recorded two tackles. The Bills now sit at 9-1 and hold a four-game lead in the AFC East standings.

items.title: Game Guide: Memphis
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – Temple football concludes its 2026 season on Black Friday, November 27, when the Owls travel to Memphis to face the Tigers at Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium. Kickoff is set for 3:30 p.m. ET on ESPN. Fans can listen to the game at OwlSports.com/listen.

items.title: Keeler shoulders blame for Temple's two-win season, looks ahead to offseason
items.summary: In his weekly Monday session with reporters, K.C. Keeler talked about Friday's season finale at Memphis and how quickly the staff will pivot to offseason preparation.

items.title: Asa Locks: A Temple Homecoming
Temple's season hits new low in 31-27 loss to Rice
items.summary: The Owls blow a 10-point lead in the span of a little less than two minutes Thursday night.

items.title: Temple Falls to Rice at Home
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – Temple football fell to Rice, 31-27, Thursday night at Lincoln Financial Field after the visiting Owls scored the go-ahead touchdown with six seconds remaining. Temple moved to 2-9 overall despite rushing for a season-high 300 yards and holding a 10-point lead with just over five minutes left.

items.title: Gameday preview: Rice at Temple
items.summary: Temple is playing for pride - and to get some answers about the future of its roster - when it takes on Rice Thursday night at Lincoln Financial Field.

items.summary: A handful of Temple commits are still alive in their respective playoffs. Find out how the future Owls performed in this week's recruiting roundup.

items.title: Owls in the NFL - Week 10
items.summary: Sacks keep coming for Titans' linebacker Jacob Martin (2014-17). He recorded yet another sack on Sunday, bringing his season total to 7.5. Martin has now recorded at least one sack in six of his nine games this season. The Titans fell to the Jaguars, 40-23, while tight end David Martin-Robinson (2018-23) did not record any statistics.

items.title: Temple adds Pleasantville playmaker Raliel Wiggins to 2027 class
items.summary: Wiggins spoke with OwlScoop about his decision to commit to Temple, where he will be paired with his current high school teammate, Ta'kiesse Barnes.

items.title: Jaxon Smolik will start Thursday against Rice, K.C. Keeler says
items.summary: The Penn State transfer nearly led a comeback win at Navy. He'll get another shot Thursday.

items.summary: MEMPHIS, TENN. - The American Conference announced Monday afternoon that on Friday, Nov. 27 the contest between the Temple Owls and Memphis Tigers in Memphis, Tenn. will kickoff at 3:30 p.m.

items.title: Game Guide: Rice
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – Temple football closes its 2026 home schedule on Thursday, November 19, when Rice visits Lincoln Financial Field for the first meeting between the two programs. Kickoff is set for 7:30 p.m. ET, with the game televised on ESPN and available on OwlSports.com/listen.

items.summary: The Owls trailed by three at halftime before getting shut out in the second half. They're 2-8 now with two games remaining.

items.title: Temple Football Ousted by UAB
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – Temple football fell to UAB, 36-10, Saturday afternoon at Lincoln Financial Field. The Owls moved to 2-8 overall and 1-5 in American Conference play, while the Blazers improved to 6-4 and 4-2.

items.title: Temple Football vs. UAB Remains Unchanged Ahead of Saturday’s Contest
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – The Temple-UAB football game, scheduled to be played at Lincoln Financial Field on Saturday, Nov. 14 at 1:00 p.m., has not been affected by the FAA National Ground Stop going on within the country.
